lead.claim: BCR monitoring helps identify patients at high risk for voiding dysfunction.
lead.context: Why this matters: This systematic review assessed intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex monitoring for predicting postoperative voiding dysfunction after lumbosacral spine surgery.

supporting.claim: Return to competition after ACLR is not the only measure of player success.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This cohort study examined return to competition and career sustainability in football players after primary ACL reconstruction.

supporting.claim: Transparent team communication is crucial for using patient-centered outcomes data.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This commentary discussed the challenges of systematically using patient-centered outcomes data to improve rehabilitation care.

supporting.claim: Consider adding VR to TKA rehab for better pain, function, and balance.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This randomized controlled trial investigated the effect of adding virtual reality-based therapy to conventional physiotherapy after total knee arthroplasty.

supporting.claim: A novel armrest can boost unsupervised upper extremity movement practice early post-stroke.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This randomized controlled trial explored a new wheelchair armrest device to promote arm movement in stroke inpatients.
